products.body_html:
• PRE-ORDER. Ships around October 22nd.
  • Hardcover, with dustjacket
  • 256 pages
  • Full color
  • Includes expert commentaries from golf logo designers
  • Limited Collectors Edition are signed and numbered, with slipcase
  • This item is not available for return or exchange. 

Written by New York Times-bestselling author George Peper, with a foreword by PGA Tour legend Brad Faxon, THE BEST LOGOS IN GOLF brings together the 100 most iconic, memorable, and influential logos from golf clubs and country clubs around the world. Selected by a panel of passionate experts known as the “Logo Lads,” (including our founder, Ian Gilley!) the book blends design insight with rich storytelling to illuminate the icons that define the game.


Far more than decorative crests stitched onto polos or printed on scorecards, golf logos serve as powerful emblems of tradition, identity, and place. THE BEST LOGOS IN GOLF traces the evolution of these designs—from their roots in classic heraldry to the modern balance of heritage and minimalism—revealing how animals, typography, colors, and geography all contribute to a club’s visual language.


Featuring full-color imagery across 256 pages, the book includes high-res logos from 100 different clubs, plus  expert commentaries from leading golf logo designers Seth McWhorter, Ian Gilley, and Kate Smith-Stroh. Each featured logo is accompanied by stories that bring its meaning to life, offering readers a deeper understanding of the traditions, rivalries, and cultural shifts embedded within these enduring marks.

 
Whether you’re a golfer, designer, historian, or collector, THE BEST LOGOS IN GOLF invites readers to see the game through a new lens—one shaped not by scores, but by symbols. From storied private clubs to creative resort brands to modern redesigns, the book captures the artistry and evolution of golf’s visual identity in a way that is both authoritative and engaging.


Beautifully produced as a premium hardcover with dust jacket, in standard edition and limited edition (signed, numbered, slipcase), THE BEST LOGOS IN GOLF is destined to become an essential addition to any golf library and a conversation piece for years to come.

This item is not available for return or exchange.

products.title: Double Seve High Crown Visor
products.body_html:
Our beloved “Double Seve” High Crown Visor: everyone knows the story of the original; in 1986 the Spaniard was rocking a tour visor with the Club logo for the first few rounds of the year's first major. Turned out, come Sunday, he was close to the lead and team swoosh was eager to capitalize on the TV time their high profile staffer was bound to get. So, they took two shirt labels, applied them on top of the existing mark and a legend was born - a torch that we have been carrying forward since day one of SSC. 

And so, this incarnation pays literal tribute to 1986’s with two SSC Arrow labels placed right on top of our embroidered Play or Perish mark, with a bit of the corners peering through on purpose to assure you that it’s there. Also, the top label of Seve’s visor had an “M” because it was from a medium shirt - you will find that present on our top Arrow as well. Anyhoo, all these little silly details are extremely important to us as this is the blue chip product in our Double Seve offering. 

Made in the USA.
